carmen: kicking off Spectra Labs perf run this morning — baseline vs q4 quick smoke then a 45m soak later today.
ishaan: target numbers?
carmen: customer wants 99p < 300ms at sustained 500 qps, peaks 2k qps. quick smoke (20m @ 250 qps, seq=64): baseline p50 58ms p95 130ms p99 285ms. q4 p50 48ms p95 140ms p99 spikes at ~720ms (small sample).
fiona: q4 median looks good but tail is concerning. any obvious correlation?
carmen: spikes align with concurrent cold prefix windows and brief NVLink saturation. prefetch async was enabled. run cmd we used:
```
./bench --model redwood-large-v1 --variant q4_0 --seq 64 --qps 250 --concurrency 8 --prefetch async --ramp 300
```
ishaan: plan: run 3x45m soak at 500 qps with 40% unique prefixes, one run with kv-pin candidate. collect nvlink, memcpy stalls, kv hit ratios.
ops-bot: ded pool candidate "ded-nyc-8g" available 2026-06-24 01:00-04:00 UTC.
carmen: procurement asked for reserved uplift for 2k peak (10% headroom) vs PAYG ballpark by EOD. any quick numbers?
ishaan: back-of-envelope: reserved + SLA ~ $20k/mo, PAYG ~ $36k/mo. if kv-pin stabilizes q4 tail we can shift them to quant path and reduce token spend ~15%.
legal: Spectra needs KMS in their AWS account + BAA for PHI. Dedicated supports customer KMS and CloudHSM; we'll start BAA intake.
fiona: action items:
- ishaan/fiona: run the 3x45m soaks with and without kv-pin during ded-nyc-8g slot (target slot above)
- carmen: send provisional reserved vs PAYG ballpark to procurement by EOD and ask for go-live month
- legal: kick off BAA and confirm CloudHSM compatibility
ops-bot: please confirm slot booking if you want to reserve.
carmen: will reserve the slot and post raw CSVs + flamegraphs after runs. if we get 99p < 300ms at 500 qps on Dedicated, sales will move to a 12mo commit. :rocket:
